title: Fix connectBot event listener leak on reconnect (P1 audit)
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-MF-007): connectBot() creates new bot and registers handlers without removing old ones. On reconnect, duplicate listeners accumulate — each event fires N times after N reconnections. Add removeAllListeners() before re-registration. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P1-006)
